ValidationRule.description: Do not allow any changes to IDR system task if the subject is changed or the task is completed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, !ISNEW(), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'IDR_System_Task', OR ( Text(PRIORVALUE(Status)) = 'Completed', Text(PRIORVALUE(Status)) = 'Failed', ISCHANGED(Subject) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorized to make updates to this record.
